taxa.name_boundary: Phalaris angusta Nees ex Trin. (1827) is a distinct accepted species, while the later illegitimate homonym Phalaris angusta Schltdl. (1851) is synonymized under P. caroliniana. Likewise P. intermedia var. angusta (Nees ex Trin.) Chapm. maps to accepted P. angusta, but P. intermedia var. angustata Beal maps to P. caroliniana. Do not auto-map authorless 'Phalaris angusta', or conflate angusta with angustata.
taxa.duplicate_guardrail: Only existing P. caroliniana card was in installed Phalaris folder at review; do not create synonym cards or assume P. angusta installed.
